newsitem.title: POLAND: Commerzbank cleared to up BRE stake.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank cleared to up BRE stake.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission cleared Germany's Commerzbank AG to increase its stake in Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA beyond 33 percent, the commission said on Tuesday.
In a statement it said that it would not object to Commerzbank gaining more than 50 percent of BRE shares if it resulted from a purchase of shares through a public tender offer.
Any shareholder acquiring more than 33 percent control of the company is obliged by law to offer to buy all remaining shares from other shareholders.

Commerzbank last month said it planned to increase its stake in BRE to 48.8 percent from the current 32.8 percent by acquiring a new 4.5-million-share issue provided it received a clearance from the Polish authorities.
